Its consequence is real and the seat owns the successor: every `os-dev-report` comment carries no session id BY CONTRACT (`.claude/agents/os-dev.md` :362–:365 names `issue` / `branch` / `pr` and no session field; the platform appends only the bare footer), so 7 of the 10 live rows are dev reports and card bodies of that shape — a rules-layer card on `os-dev.md` is filed by the seat in the same act as the ACCEPT, and until it lands the anchor's H64 rows name dev reports whose clearing act is the report template.
